t: This is King Street, the main shopping street in Hammersmith. It runs west to east as part of the A315, continuing on from Chiswick High Road, and at its eastern end it reaches Hammersmith Broadway, where it carries on as Hammersmith Road. Stamford Brook tube station is close to the western end. The street is named after John King, who was Bishop of London from 1611 to 1621.
